scope: Gateway control ingress, queued authority and bounded control packet parsing; not physical input delivery
changes: WebRTC pollers send decoded input directly to the existing authorized bounded command queue; no intervening unbound application input queue
ControlGrant is fixed at enqueue and checked again before native forwarding, including A-to-B-to-A transfers
Forbidden input is rejected before queuing; overflow terminates the attachment so the existing runtime releases held input
Control channel polling/sending tasks are owned by JoinSet; ending a task ends the attachment, and dropping the channel cancels its tasks
Truncated packet lengths, input length below four, and oversized text copies no longer reach the identified panic paths; decoder trace excludes the payload
